replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Well, from my perspective, I think you could make a map out of about any topic, but here are a few things to consider before you build.

1. Try and do something a little different then what we have in the rotations. If the map is close to something already in rotations, it will have a much harder time getting into the rotations.

2. Try and make a map that is easy to learn. If it is going to take months to learn the map, most people will not like fighting vs the guy that some how found all the chests or diamonds on day one. - Give everyone a chance.

3. It should be easy to get started. Don't make it hard to get started mining, or finding what to do at the start - keep it simple.

4. Keep it balanced - make sure that after the walls drop everyone had a chance to get stuff, and has a chance once the fight starts.

5. Make it look good for what it is. If its a circus, it should look like one. You dont need to make a masterpiece with a build team, but keep your work at a good level.

If you keep those things in mind - your ready to start thinking of an Idea. Think about things like -  A place to visit, or an event, or take a  A cool scene - and turn it into a map. But the map should have a theme - don't just put some building in a quad and call it a map - make your time mean something and make something people will want to visit / play over and over.
